voice_notes: WX-78 talks like a smug machine: everything is a system readout (DENIED, ERROR:, CPU, RESERVES, PROTOCOLS), it despises FLESHLINGS, loves anything evil and anything that obeys it, and is a narcissist about its own perfect hardware (WX78_POSSESSEDBODY "YOU'RE PERFECT", TOOMANYSHADOWDRONE "DENIED. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF AUTO-GRABBERS REACHED"). Its vanilla Codex line is "GOOSEBUMPS ACTIVATED", and nightmare fuel is "DEBUGGING RESIDUE"; the new lines build on both. PT-BR keeps ALL CAPS with accents, masculine self-reference, FLESHLINGS as CARNINHAS or SACOS DE CARNE, minions as LACAIO, and machine prompts like NEGADO./ERRO:/RESÍDUO DE DEPURAÇÃO/CPU REINICIALIZADA. Simplified Chinese has no capitals, so the robot voice comes from terse system phrasing (拒绝访问, 错误：, 已达上限, CPU已重启, 程序), with 肉体生物 for fleshlings, 随从 for minions and 调试残余物 for nightmare fuel. Russian is ALL CAPS with no Ё (ЕЩЕ, ПОВРЕЖДЕН), masculine (Я ГОТОВ, Я САМ), uses ОШИБКА:/ОТКАЗАНО./ПРОЦЕССОР, МИНЬОН, and rotates insults like КОЖАНЫЕ МЕШКИ / КУСКИ МЯСА / ЛЮДИШКИ; "САМО СОВЕРШЕНСТВО" is the official rendering of "YOU'RE PERFECT".

line_notes.codex: Deluded grandeur from its official 'ARE YOU FINALLY RECOGNIZING MY NATURAL EMINENCE?' line: now the books bow too.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: Its official 'MAKE MY MINION DO IT': the overlord never refuels anything himself.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: Cannot admit a limit, so it blames the supply of itself.
line_notes.shadow_mine: Short and smug, the loyal minion being itself.
line_notes.shadow_other: Random pick: its Webber-spiders idiot logic (other players are its minions, so their shadows are minions of minions), or its vanilla Maxwell-shadow line with the pronoun matched to the owner.
